summary: Frontend-only mobile testing at 375x667 passed for offline dashboard loading, profile home-appearance section, all six wallpaper selections, gallery button availability, navigation isolation, and reload persistence.

integration_issues.issue: ImagePicker launch is not wrapped in try/finally or error handling; a rejected/native picker error can leave isPicking true indefinitely and provide no safe error state.

action_items: Wrap gallery picker call in try/finally and expose a recoverable error state when native permission/picker fails.
Add testID home-screen to the dashboard root for robust automated/mobile regression targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard has no data-testid/testID despite being a critical screen; the live UI is functional but required selector-based verification cannot target it directly.
Wallpaper selection persistence uses AsyncStorage correctly and wallpaper backdrop is rendered only in Dashboard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% executed supported flows; native gallery failure path not reproducible in web preview

seed_data_creation: No transaction seed data created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 375x667. Dashboard must currently be located by visible text because home-screen testID is missing. Six preset IDs tested: obsidian, emerald, ocean, plum, ember, slate.
rca_of_issue: The gallery handler sets isPicking true, awaits launchImageLibraryAsync, then resets it only on normal resolution. Native cancellation is handled, but thrown permission/provider errors bypass reset and the user receives no error feedback.
